results.reference: Interference becomes higher than threshold
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.10, Event I1 (Interference becomes higher than threshold)
results.model_answer:
Event I1 triggers based on the interference measurement result (Mi) compared to a threshold (Thresh) with hysteresis (Hys). Specifically, the UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition I1-1 is fulfilled, and the leaving condition when condition I1-2 is fulfilled, where:

- Mi > Thresh + Hys (entering condition)
- Mi < Thresh - Hys (leaving condition)

Mi is the measurement result of the interference, not taking into account any offsets. Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. i1-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event). Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event). Mi and Thresh are expressed in dBm, and Hys is expressed in dB.
results.evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.10, Event I1 (Interference becomes higher than threshold)
